title: Who left South Congress, and who came
subtitle: Four years of turnover on the Austin corridor, storefront by storefront
alt: Timeline of business turnover on South Congress Avenue in Austin: Lucy in Disguise with Diamonds closed in 2022 after 38 years and Tesoros Trading Company retired after 33 years, with On and Tecovas later taking those spaces; Hermes opened in 2022, followed by Sezane, Birkenstock and Lucchese; Maya Star closed in 2023 after nearly 30 years; in 2026 Vespaio, Chapulin Cantina, Prototype Vintage and Tiny Grocer closed and Monkey See Monkey Do moved to South Lamar Boulevard after 20 years; and Taste of Ethiopia leaves when its lease expires on Sept. 30, 2026
source: Business openings and closings reported by KVUE
